description: The pie chart visually represents the distribution of video content categories used in the study “Enhancing Multimodal LLM for Detailed and Accurate Video Captioning using Multi-Round Preference Optimization.” It is divided into 14 distinct segments, each labeled with a content category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is “People Blogs” at 17.2%, followed by “Howto” at 9.7%, “Entertainment” at 13.9%, and “Education” at 8.7%. Other categories include “Film Animation” (4.6%), “Sports” (7.7%), “Gaming” (6.4%), “Travel Events” (4.6%), “Comedy” (5.6%), “Science Technology” (6.4%), “News Politics” (4.3%), “Pets Animals” (3.9%), “Autos Vehicles” (4.8%), and “Music” (2.3%). Each slice is color-coded and labeled with its percentage, and the chart includes a legend for “Howto” in gray, though the legend is minimal. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top, with no apparent sorting by size, and no slices are exploded or emphasized visually. The chart provides a clear proportional breakdown of the dataset’s categorical composition for training or evaluating the multimodal LLM.
